final: WITH account_region AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS signed_transaction_total, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), regional AS (SELECT region_name, SUM(signed_transaction_total) AS regional_sum FROM account_region GROUP BY region_name) SELECT ar.account_id, ar.region_name, ar.signed_transaction_total, ar.record_count, ar.signed_transaction_total / r.regional_sum AS ratio FROM account_region AS ar JOIN regional AS r ON ar.region_name = r.region_name ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
